title: LS_34156_PH_ManilaWalk.mp3 by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Street atmosphere in Manila, Philippines. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). This binaural audio file is one of the recordings I made in Manila a few days before Christmas 2018, while I was rambling in the shops and in the crowded streets of Divisoria and Baklaran, which are two places where you can find many sellers and vendors who sell everything you’d like to buy... Here, I’m walking in a small street with many vendors and small shops around. Recorded in December 2018 with an Olympus LS-3 and Soundman OKM I binaural microphones (version 2018).
